title: Senior Engineering Intelligence Analyst
jobDescription:

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

Senior Engineering Intelligence Analyst

Role Summary
We are looking for a hands-on analytics engineer to build, maintain, and evolve Five9’s engineering
intelligence platform. You will be the technical engine behind a growing function that provides data-
driven insights to engineering leadership across a portfolio of 1,000+ features and $100M+ in
engineering investment.
You will work with data from Jira, Jellyfish, Salesforce, and other systems to build automated pipelines,
interactive dashboards, and analytical tools that enable faster, smarter decisions. This role is ideal for
someone who combines strong data engineering fundamentals with a passion for making data
accessible and actionable—someone who gets excited about building a pipeline as much as crafting a
clear visualization.

Responsibilities
Dashboard Development & Maintenance (40%)
Build and maintain sophisticated, interactive dashboards in Looker covering feature delivery
predictions, FTE allocation, resource contention, and portfolio health.
Migrate existing HTML-based dashboards to the enterprise Looker platform while preserving and
enhancing analytical depth.
Design intuitive, self-service visualizations that enable engineering leaders to explore data and
answer their own questions.
Implement and analyze DORA metrics (Deploy Frequency, Lead Time, Change Failure Rate, MTTR) to
measure and improve Dev Ops performance.
Implement alerting and anomaly detection to proactively surface risks (e.g., feature slippage,
resource over-allocation, stale work items).

Data Engineering & Integration (35%)
Build and maintain robust, automated data pipelines integrating Jira (REST API, Structure exports),
Jellyfish APIs, Salesforce, and other internal systems into Google Big Query.
Write and optimize complex SQL queries and Python scripts to extract, transform, and load data.
Page 2 of 2
Build and maintain scalable and efficient data models using Look ML, establishing a “source of truth”
for engineering metrics.
Implement data quality checks, automated validation, and monitoring to ensure accuracy and
freshness with a near-real-time SLA.
Optimize query performance and data models for sub-second dashboard response times.
Analysis & Insight Support (25%)
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to analyze data from Jira and Jellyfish, providing
insights into team performance, project delivery, and resource allocation.
Engage in business analysis to understand stakeholder needs, gather requirements, and translate
them into technical specifications for data models and reports.
Support leadership in preparing executive-ready analyses and insight decks for QBRs and other
strategic reviews.
Document data lineage, calculation methodologies, and dashboard logic for transparency and
auditability.

Skills, Competencies, and Qualifications
Required
5-8 years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or a related
technical analytics role.
Expert-level proficiency in SQL (complex joins, window functions, CTEs, performance optimization).
Proficiency in Python for data processing (e.g., pandas, requests, scheduled jobs).
Hands-on experience with Looker, including Look ML data modeling, advanced dashboard design,
and performance optimization.
Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines with REST API data sources.
Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and how
engineering organizations operate.
Strong data visualization skills with a proven ability to design dashboards that tell a clear story.

Preferred
Experience with Jira APIs, Jira Structure, and the Atlassian ecosystem at scale.
Familiarity with Engineering Management Platforms like Jellyfish.
Experience with Looker and Look ML.
Experience with cloud data platforms, specifically Google Big Query.
Exposure to engineering metrics (DORA, flow efficiency, cycle time, throughput).
HTML/Java Script skills for custom visualizations and rapid prototyping

In this role, you will own the full-cycle recruitment process for both technical and non-technical positions, partnering closely with hiring managers and business leaders to attract, engage, and hire top talent.

Location: Bangalore, India (Hybrid – 3 days per week in office)

Employment Type: Contract (6 Months)

Reporting To: Manager, Talent Acquisition (India)

What You'll Do

  • Manage end-to-end recruitment for technical and non-technical roles across India.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong sourcing skills with the ability to identify and engage passive candidates.

  • Experience managing candidate pipelines, interview coordination, reporting, and recruitment workflows within an Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

  • Ability to manage multiple requisitions simultaneously while maintaining a high level of quality and responsiveness.

  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Comfortable working with global stakeholders across multiple time zones, including the United States.

  • Experience working in a global or multinational organization.

title: Principal AI Solutions Architect
jobDescription:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

Principal AI Solutions Architect

ABOUT THE ROLE

Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of Five9 AI and automation to organizations worldwide. The Enterprise-AI Team drives Five9's internal adoption of AI — turning emerging capability into real business outcomes across the company.

The Principal AI Solutions Architect is the most senior technical voice on the team and the design authority for Five9's internal AI work — the person who turns an approved solution concept into a buildable technical architecture. You partner with the business-facing solutions lead, who owns what a solution must achieve and why; you own how it is built — the reference architecture, data and integration design, model / agent / platform selection, security and governance fit, and the technical standards the engineering team builds to. The role demands someone who stays current at all times on the fast-moving AI platform, model, agent, and tooling landscape and on emerging architecture patterns, so every design reflects the best available approach and is sound, secure, and feasible before the build begins.

HOW YOU CONTRIBUTE

  • Technical solution design — Translate an approved solution concept into an end-to-end technical architecture — components, data flows, integration and API surface, model / agent selection, and non-functional requirements — captured as a clear, buildable design.
  • Reference architecture & standards — Define and maintain the reusable patterns, guardrails, and technical standards the engineering team builds to; keep them current as capabilities and tooling evolve.
  • Platform & build-vs-buy strategy — Evaluate models, vendors, frameworks, and cloud-platform options; recommend fit, cost, and trade-offs with a clear rationale.
  • Data & integration design — Design how each solution accesses, moves, and secures company and business data; define the integrations and interfaces the build requires.
  • Security, governance & responsible-AI fit — Design to information-security, data-classification, and responsible-AI requirements from the start; carry designs through architecture and security review.
  • Design handoff & build support — Package the technical design to a buildable standard and support the engineering team through implementation as their technical counterpart.
  • Continuous currency — Maintain always-current command of the AI platform, model, agent, and tooling landscape and emerging architecture patterns, so every design reflects the best available approach.
  • Technical advisory — Advise business partners, engineers, and leadership on feasibility, risk, effort, and sequencing; pressure-test solution designs for technical soundness before they advance.
  • Cross-functional partnership — Partner with enterprise architecture, information security, and platform / Dev Ops teams so designs move cleanly from concept into governed delivery.

SKILLS, COMPETENCIES & QUALIFICATIONS — REQUIRED

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 12+ years in solution / software / enterprise architecture, ML / AI engineering, or technical solutions / pre-sales engineering — including hands-on design of production systems and setting technical direction others build to.
  • Demonstrated ability to design end-to-end technical architectures for AI / ML or data-intensive systems (components, data flows, integrations, non-functionals, and security).
  • Strong command of the modern AI stack — LLMs, agent frameworks, retrieval / RAG, orchestration, tool integration, AI-augmented development — with a demonstrated habit of staying continuously current.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Google Cloud preferred) and modern delivery tooling (Git-based version control, CI / CD, infrastructure-as-code).
  • Ability to produce clear, buildable architecture artifacts (reference diagrams, data / integration designs, architecture decision records) and communicate them to both engineers and executives.
  • Working knowledge of security, data-classification, and responsible-AI requirements in an enterprise setting.

SKILLS, COMPETENCIES & QUALIFICATIONS — PREFERRED

  • Experience in or with contact center / CX technology (Five9 or comparable), or applying AI to CX.
  • Familiarity with responsible-AI, model-risk, and enterprise / solution architecture review practices.
  • Experience defining reusable architecture patterns or platform standards for a delivery team.
  • Prior work at the business / technology boundary in a central enterprise-AI, platform, or transformation function.
  • Cloud (Google Cloud) or enterprise-architecture certifications.

WHERE THIS ROLE SITS

  • Primary focus: technical solution design & architecture — Owns how every AI solution is built — from approved concept to a buildable technical architecture.
  • Works alongside the business solutions lead — The business solutions lead owns what a solution must achieve and why; this role owns how it is built.
  • Partners with the engineering team — Hands the buildable technical design to the engineers and supports implementation as their technical counterpart.

KEY RELATIONSHIPS

No direct reports (provides technical leadership to the engineering team). Key partners: the business-facing solutions lead · the engineering team · enterprise architecture · information security · platform / Dev Ops. You partner most closely with the business solutions lead on solution design — you own the technical design, they own the business design — and with the engineers on delivery.

title: Technical Support Engineer
jobDescription:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly motivated Technical Support Engineer to manage day-to-day operational activities related to Moves, Adds, Changes, and Deletions (MACD) along with production support for enterprise contact center environments.

The role involves handling service requests, configuring contact center solutions, supporting production incidents, and ensuring timely resolution of issues while meeting defined SLAs. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical skills, effective customer communication abilities, and hands-on experience with contact center technologies and integrations.

Key Responsibilities

As a Technical Support Engineer, you will:

  • Process and manage MACD (Moves, Adds, Changes, and Deletions) requests through ticketing systems
  • Configure and implement changes in contact center environments as per customer requirements
  • Validate configurations and ensure successful completion of service requests
  • Track request status and ensure adherence to SLAs
  • Understand customer business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
  • Act as a Product SME (Subject Matter Expert) during customer discussions, deployment planning, and solution rollout activities
  • Communicate deployment and configuration approaches effectively with both business stakeholders and technical teams
  • Configure, integrate, validate, and deploy software components in customer production and non-production environments
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including Product Engineering, Cloud Operations, QA, and Support teams during deployment and configuration activities
  • Perform solution validation, system integration testing, UAT support, and production readiness verification
  • Create and execute test cases based on business scenarios and customer requirements
  • Troubleshoot deployment, configuration, integration, and production issues in a structured and analytical manner
  • Prepare deployment documents, runbooks, solution design documents, and operational handover documentation
  • Support production migrations, upgrade activities, and post-production stabilization activities
  • Provide customer training, knowledge transfer sessions, and solution design walkthroughs
  • Participate in customer calls, status reviews, and technical discussions to ensure successful project delivery
  • Monitor service request milestones and proactively identify risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans
  • Ensure adherence to deployment and configuration standards, security practices, and operational best practices

Qualifications & Skills

Contact Center Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of contact center technologies and omnichannel communication platforms
  • Experience working with contact center solutions such as any of these:
    • Cisco UCCE
    • Amazon Connect
    • NICE In Contact
    • Twilio
    • Avaya
    • Genesys
    • Five9 or similar platforms

Understanding on Contact Center Components

  • Dialers
  • ACD
  • IVR
  • CTI
  • Campaign Management
  • Agent Desktop Integrations

Technical Skills

  • Experience with outbound contact center products and campaign management workflows
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to derive solution approaches and prepare technical solution design documents
  • Hands-on experience in SQL is mandatory
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, Postman, and API-based integrations
  • Knowledge of log analysis, monitoring, and production issue troubleshooting
  • Exposure to automation, scripting, or deployment tools is an added advantage

Communication & Customer Handling

  • Strong communication, customer handling, and stakeholder management skills
  • Good listening, comprehension, and consultative engagement skills with customers
  • Willingness to work in customer-facing environments and support critical deployment activities when required

Additional Experience

  • Experience in cloud-based contact center deployments

What We Expect

  • Ownership mindset with strong accountability toward customer success
  • Ability to work during critical production activities
  • Proactive communication and coordination across teams
  • Strong focus on quality, stability, and operational excellence
  • Continuous learning mindset with interest in new technologies and evolving contact center platforms

Shift: Night Shift
Work Mode: Work from office

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal.

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.
